name: ai_agent
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk AI Agent — an external AI service or model the help desk can invoke to perform automated tasks. Agents are assigned to personas, which determine where they are available.

attributes.name: endpoint
attributes.description: Absolute URL of the HTTP(S) endpoint the help desk calls to invoke this agent. Must be a well-formed absolute URL.

attributes.name: does_support_streaming
attributes.description: Whether the agent supports streaming (Server-Sent Events) responses.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Whether the agent is active and available for use. Defaults to active when omitted.

attributes.name: metadata
attributes.description: Free-form key/value configuration for the agent (e.g. model, maxTokens, systemPrompt).

attributes.name: endpoint_details
attributes.description: Additional configuration for invoking the agent endpoint.

attributes.name: path
attributes.description: Path the help desk invokes the agent on.

attributes.name: method
attributes.description: HTTP method used to invoke the agent.

attributes.name: http_headers
attributes.description: HTTP headers sent when invoking the agent.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the agent was created (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the agent was last updated (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version counter, incremented on each update.
